people.name: Udaya Nanayakkara
people.note: Son of the founder. Took the business on in 1981.

milestones.title: A travel house opens in Colombo
milestones.text: Ceylon Carriers Travels starts arranging journeys in and out of Sri Lanka, grown out of the family's inland trucking and logistics business.

milestones.title: The second generation takes over
milestones.text: Charles Nanayakkara hands the business to his son, Udaya Nanayakkara.

milestones.title: Still run from Colombo 07
milestones.text: Udaya Nanayakkara chairs the company. The team below plans inbound tours and holidays abroad from the office at Horton Place.
